header: Scores from several platforms in one row
lead: Two to six scores. The unit names the scale, so 4.7 out of 5 and 92 out of 100 can sit side by side.
note: Use the note for the date the scores were read and what they include.

scores.title: Scores in a row

scores.title: A number, not stars
scores.text: Stars would misrepresent a score like 92 out of 100
